scene: Inside the crate, three transport tokens glow beside a bustling transit dock.
picture: Side-scrolling view along a bustling transit jetty at the reef edge. Far left, a chairlift swings beside its operator. Centre left, the boy stands with his kite pack, holding tokens. Centre, a red sleigh tram idles on frosty tracks. Far right, a large striped hot-air balloon floats, tethered securely above the wooden boards.
shown: a dangling two-seat chairlift swinging at a small wooden platform on the left
a red runners-equipped sleigh tram idling on iron rails in the centre
a tethered striped hot-air balloon with an open wicker basket on the right
